name: Wired
author: Louis Pearson
description: Collect coins by solving puzzles with wires and circuits. Left/right to move, Up/Down to interact above or below, Z to grab wires and flip switches, X to jump.

descriptions.en: Collect coins by solving puzzles with wires and circuits. Left/right to move, Up/Down to interact above or below, Z to grab wires and flip switches, X to jump.
descriptions.it: Raccogli monete risolvendo enigmi con fili e circuiti. Sinistra/destra per muoverti, su/giù per interagire sopra o sotto, Z per fili e leve, X per saltare.
